top.line: How our open-source stack could plug into UAlgTec Heritage, the Algarve's new European heritage centre.
top.para: A mapping, a pilot, and the answer to its form.

in-short.line: A HeritageTech sector on an AI-first platform needs proof; our stack provides it; six places; a pilot.

uth.line: UTH: University of the Algarve, ICArEHB, about 31.5 million euros, Teaming for Excellence, from 2027.
uth.para: Consortium with Kiel University, ERA Arqueologia and Zartis.

fit.line: Heritage is evidence; with AI in the loop, every claim needs to carry its proof.

map.line: Site vaults, signed records, append lanes, site graphs, agents with limits, public stories with proof.
map.para: Plus offline voice notes and EU self-hosting.

bring.line: UTH brings science, sites and funding; we bring an open trust stack running daily.
bring.para: Both: AI that makes expert knowledge more trustworthy.

pilot.line: One site, one season, twelve weeks: keys, vault, signed records, a graph, a public page.
pilot.para: Open source; results belong to the centre.

form.line: Option two, a technology for heritage, leading to a collaboration, with a short draft answer.

limits.line: A proposal; UTH's plans as reported; our stack untested on an excavation.

sources.line: UTH's form and screen, FCT and regional press, and earlier articles.
